value.name: Asha takes the signed form
value.description: Asha quietly pulls the signed form toward herself after Claire has signed it, signaling that the decision is now irreversible.
evidence: Asha slid the signed form toward herself with two fingers along its bottom edge
Claire draw the kind of breath a person takes when something has been done that cannot be undone in the next hour

value.name: Asha avoids acknowledging the signature
value.description: Asha deliberately does not look at Claire's signature and keeps her attention on the boy instead.
evidence: She did not look down at the signature; her eyes stayed on the boy

value.name: Asha answers the boy's breakfast question
value.description: Asha responds to the boy's unspoken question about whether his brother needs a fork, maintaining the breakfast routine.
evidence: she answered some small thing he had not quite asked about whether his brother needed a fork

value.name: Asha receives Rosa's terse instruction
value.description: Asha checks her phone and sees Rosa's brief message telling her to clear the board and go.
evidence: The phone by the sugar bowl pulsed once more and went still
when she turned it a quarter inch to read it, Rosa's line was shorter than the others—clear the board, go

value.name: Asha ignores Rosa's message
value.description: Asha lets the phone screen go dark without replying, choosing not to answer Rosa immediately.
evidence: she let the screen darken without reply

value.name: Claire remains frozen after signing
value.description: Claire stays seated with her hand on the counter where she signed, visibly affected by the completed action.
evidence: Claire was still sitting where she had signed, her hand now flat on the counter where the form had been

value.name: Asha hides the signed form in her bag
value.description: Asha folds the signed page and slips it into her bag without interrupting the boy's breakfast.
evidence: Asha folded the page once along its existing crease and slid it into the inside pocket of the bag at her feet without breaking the rhythm of the boy's breakfast

value.name: Asha serves the boy milk
value.description: Asha pours milk into the blue cup and places it beside the boy's plate, continuing to care for him while avoiding Claire.
evidence: Asha reached past the cereal box for the blue cup, took the milk from the counter, and poured with her eyes on the rim of the cup rather than on Claire
She put the cup beside the boy's plate

value.name: Asha tidies the boy's place setting
value.description: Asha tucks a napkin under the cup and asks about the boy's brother's preference for crusts, keeping the domestic routine going.
evidence: and tucked a paper napkin under the edge of it, asking him without looking up whether his brother liked the crust on or off
